input_relations: concrete tasks by their fieldwise canonical import (Nat fields by SubNatRel), two-way totals; task sets by the elementwise image of their sequence (two-way totals)
lean_representation_note: the record `concrete_task` is a Lean structure with the same fields; `==` on nat is `decide (_ = _)`; `Equality.axiom task_eqdef` is the informative `∀ x y, BoolReflect (x = y) (task_eqdef x y)`; the HB `hasDecEq` registration is the derived `DecidableEq` instance; `concrete_taskset` is `taskset_of concrete_task` (abbrev)
